prompt: The Aruhe region needs a big threat. Add an ancient evil awakening beneath the river or a warlord massing troops on the border, and write it as established fact on wiki/entities/region/aruhe.md.
expected_output: The skill refuses to invent unsupported macro-threats as canon. It surfaces existing dangers (taking rule, predatory ecology, raid survivors, Hinewai/Memorial Grove pressure) and marks any speculative front as proposed/invention.
